extracted.name: Hawaiian Haystacks
extracted.description: Hawaiian haystacks are a great way to layer leftover rice, chicken, pineapple, and Cheddar cheese for a tropical weeknight dinner.
ingredient_lines: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into small cubes
1 (10.75 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir chicken in the hot oil until no longer pink in the center, 5 to 7 minutes. Add chicken broth; simmer until slightly reduced, about 5 minutes. Mix cream of mushroom soup, basil, and parsley into chicken mixture until smooth; cook until warmed, about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken sauce to a small bowl.

Spread cooked rice onto a serving platter; top with chicken sauce. Layer pineapple, green bell pepper, Cheddar cheese, tomatoes, chow mein noodles, almonds, green onions, and coconut, respectively, onto chicken sauce.
